caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate outfit consisting of a green frock coat with gold trim and detailing along the edges, seams, cuffs, and pockets. The coat features large gold buttons and a high, turned-down collar. Visible beneath the coat is a matching green waistcoat, also ornamented with gold trim, and what appears to be a white shirt cuff with lace extending from underneath the sleeves. The lower part of the outfit comprises a pair of red breeches that end just below the knee, each fastened at the side with buttons and a bow. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present, focusing all attention on the clothing. The outfit is shown without a head, hands, feet, or background elements.
title: Boy's Suit
